finding.claim: [low] inverseForFile() and inverseForDirectory() default to PUBLIC for any mode that is not exactly the configured public/private values. On a cross-filesystem copy with retain_visibility (default true), a restrictive source file (e.g. mode 0640) is reported as public and written to the destination as 0644, which widens access.
finding.source: Source file mode that does not equal the configured filePublic/filePrivate values (e.g. 0640, 0660, 0620). Precondition: the source was created by another process, umask, or tool, not by this library.
finding.sink: Destination write with visibility=public, which maps to filePublic 0644 (src/UnixVisibility/PortableVisibilityConverter.php:25-26)

trace.note: copy() dispatches; source and destination are on different filesystems
retain_visibility is on by default, so visibility is read from the source
forFile('public') returns 0644, so the destination is world-readable

finding.guards_checked: PortableVisibilityGuard only validates input to forFile/forDirectory, not the inverse path (src/PortableVisibilityGuard.php:11). Same-filesystem copy/move keep native modes, so widening only occurs on cross-filesystem copy. Applications that read visibility() for authorization would also see non-standard modes reported as public. The Local adapter that calls the inverse functions is not in this repo, so the trigger path there is unverified.
